title: VICBench: A Multi-Language Benchmark for Code Vulnerability Detection
abstract: arXiv:2608.12246v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Evaluating security vulnerability detection tools requires benchmark datasets with vulnerability-inducing commits (VICs) - the commits that first introduce vulnerabilities into codebases. VICs are essential for determining the full range of vulnerable software versions. Existing vulnerability datasets suffer from limited programming language coverage, restricted patch complexity, and narrow project scope. Through our dual annotation by human experts and an agentic workflow, we create a benchmark - VICBench - of 100 verified VICs for 100 CVEs across 88 projects in Python, Java, and C++, covering 48 CWE types. VICBench features complex real-world vulnerability fixes averaging 38.6 lines and corresponding VICs of 252.5 lines - significantly larger than prior work. translated_title: VICBench：一个用于代码漏洞检测的多语言基准测试
translated_abstract: 评估安全漏洞检测工具需要包含漏洞引入提交（VICs）的基准数据集——这些提交是首次将漏洞引入代码库的提交。VICs对于确定易受攻击软件版本的完整范围至关重要。现有的漏洞数据集存在编程语言覆盖有限、补丁复杂度受限和项目范围狭窄等问题。通过人类专家和代理工作流的双重标注，我们创建了一个基准测试——VICBench——包含100个经过验证的VICs，覆盖88个项目中的100个CVE，涉及Python、Java和C++，涵盖48种CWE类型。VICBench具有复杂的真实世界漏洞修复，平均为38.6行，相应的VICs为252.5行——显著大于先前的工作。我们的评估表明，最先进的算法V-SZZ和LLM4SZZ仅达到33.3%-40.1%的F1分数，确认使用现有方法仍需要大量人工工作。
tldr: 本文提出了VICBench，一个覆盖多种语言和复杂补丁的漏洞检测基准，并发现现有最先进算法在此基准上性能有限，凸显了人工干预的必要性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces VICBench, a multi-language vulnerability detection benchmark with complex patches, revealing that state-of-the-art algorithms achieve limited performance, underscoring the need for manual effort.
